content.short: Arkis provides institutional portfolio margin across CeFi, DeFi and TradFi venues.
content.description: Arkis provides prime brokerage for institutions through a single portfolio margin account spanning CeFi, DeFi and TradFi venues. Collateral sits in a tri-party arrangement with a qualified custodian, and borrowers operate from whitelisted organisation wallets with margin call and liquidation alerts. Lenders supply liquidity to the same system, and the firm states no bad debt since 2022. Its contracts were audited in December 2023, and Hyperliquid is among the venues it offers direct market access to.
content.meta: Arkis provides institutional portfolio margin and credit across CeFi, DeFi and TradFi venues.
